text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Deputy Foreign Minister Jozef Sestak said U.S. ambassador to Slovakia, Paul Johnson, had exceeded his competence when he said Slovakia had to solve the case of president son's kidnapping and the murder of another man linked to the abduction before it can be accepted into western structures.

- River transport company SPD accused Austrian authorities of underestimating the critical situation on the river Danube last week, saying this was the cause of a crash of a Slovak boat at the unfinished Freudenau power plant near Vienna.
- The SPD has repeatedly rejected allegations that the crash, in which eight Slovak sailors died, was caused either by the technical state of the boat, or a captain's error.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Production in the mining industry totalled 6.8 billion crowns in the first eight months of this year, about eight percent more than in the same period last year.
- The National Property Fund, the state privatisation agency, has the approved privatisation of another 20 state companies. The sale totalled some 822.5 million crowns.
- Engineering company Povazske Strojarne, has called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for November 7. The agenda includes a decision on issuing an unspecified tranche of bonds.

PRAVDA - A joint parliamentary committee of the European Union and Slovakia starts three-day talks in Bratislava today. The agenda of the meeting includes discussion about political situation in Slovakia.
